us.conditions: US citizens can obtain a 30-day tourist Visa on Arrival ($30 USD) or apply for an eVisa in advance.

de.conditions: German citizens can receive a Visa on Arrival (30 days, $30) or purchase an eVisa prior to travel.

gb.conditions: British passport holders are eligible for Visa on Arrival (30 days, $30) or eVisa online.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ получают визу по прибытии (VoA, 30 дней, 30$) или оформляют электронную визу онлайн.

dos.title: Respect the Angkor dress code strictly
dos.description: Shoulders and knees MUST be covered at Angkor Wat and temples; shawls over tank tops are rejected at ticket gates.

dos.title: Greet with the traditional Sampeah gesture
dos.description: Press palms together at chest level with a slight bow when greeting elders or monks.

dos.title: Carry pristine US Dollar bills
dos.description: US Dollar bills with tears, ink marks, or folded creases are routinely rejected by merchants and exchange counters.

donts.title: Don't touch anyone's head or point your feet
donts.description: The head is spiritually sacred, while feet are considered unclean; never point feet towards Buddha statues or monks.

donts.title: Don't wander off designated trails in jungle ruins
donts.description: Always remain on paved visitor paths in rural areas and ancient temple grounds due to historical landmines.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping is not traditional in rural markets but is customary (around $1-2 or 10%) for tour guides, boat drivers, and restaurant staff.
